items.desc: A compassionate and confidential virtual support group for women contemplating divorce, navigating its challenges, or healing from its impact. Offers support, reflection, renewal, and connection with women who understand.

Imagine growing up in a community where the cost of error is your life, where a single rumour can mark you for death. 
In some Muslim communities, distorted ideas of honour have been weaponised into violence, turning women into the bearers of family reputation and the targets when that reputation is ‘compromised’.

Why does ‘honour’ weighed more valuable than a women’s life? 
And what must we do collectively to dismantle the norms that allow this violence to continue?

Join us this week for this MWJA Discussion Session. 📢
🔗 Join Session here: https://t.me/MWJAGLOBAL
items.title: The Deadly Weight of "Honour"
